headword: ごみ{収集|しゅうしゅう}

definitions.explanation: The service of collecting household and commercial waste. In Japan, garbage is typically collected on scheduled days.

examples.japanese: ごみ{収集|しゅうしゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧{八時|はちじ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧です。
⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ごみ{収集|しゅうしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧だ。

⟦{祝日|しゅくじつ}→祝日：07588_shukujitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ごみ{収集|しゅうしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{収集|しゅうしゅう}{日|び}→収集日：17710_shuushuubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: There is no garbage collection on holidays, so please put it out on the next collection day.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ごみ{収集|しゅうしゅう}{日|び}: garbage collection day
- ごみ{収集|しゅうしゅう}⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧: garbage truck
- ごみ{収集|しゅうしゅう}⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧: garbage collection point

USAGE:
Garbage must be put out before the scheduled collection time, usually early morning. Each type of waste has different collection days.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{回収|かいしゅう}→回収：03019_kaishuu⟧: collection, pickup
- ⟦ごみ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦{置|お}き{場|ば}→置き場：22477_okiba⟧: garbage collection area
